description: SIDE EFFECT: publishes a comment, in the signed-in person's name, in the public discussion of one chapter, where other readers see it. Use only when the person asks to post it, with words they approved. Optional `quote` pins it to a passage (copy it exactly from the chapter); `reply_to` answers a comment from get_chapter_discussion. Every comment goes through the same moderation as on the site: one it holds is shown to the author only, and the result says so. Needs the person signed in with INITE ID and the mikefluff:discuss scope, and a chapter they may read. At most 20 comments an hour per person. For a private remark to the author use send_note_to_author instead.

body.description: The comment, as the person wants it published.

locale.description: Edition of the book whose discussion this goes to.

quote.description: An exact passage from the chapter the comment is about.

reply_to.description: Id of the comment this answers.

name: post_comment
title: Comment in a chapter's discussion
